expected.charges: Conspiracy to cause the filing of false Taft-Hartley non-Communist affidavits
expected.convicted: Convicted January 29, 1958; conviction affirmed on appeal
expected.sentence: Eighteen months in federal prison and a $2,500 fine; the prison term was served after appeals ended in 1961.

updates.sentence: Sentenced to eighteen months in federal prison and a $2,500 fine. Imprisoned at Milan in 1961 and released in July 1962. The Congressional Record of July 22, 1964, p. 16594 describes fifteen months served beginning in April 1961; a contemporary April 26, 1964 newspaper report reprinted February 26, 1969 places the start in March 1961. The conflicting start month remains unresolved; the eighteen-month sentence is not used as verified time served.
